title: CWP/37967/2025 of NAVNEET KAUR AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA
text:
3 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 118 CWP-37967-2025 (O&M) Date of decision : 19.12.2025 Navneet Kaur and others sesees Petitioners VERSUS Stateof Punjab and others ae Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA seo Present :- Mr. Kanwaljit Singh, Senior Advocate with Mr. Ajaivir Singh, Advocate for the petitioners. seo Deepinder Singh Nalwa, J. (Oral)

1. In the present writ petition, the petitioners are praying for issuance of a direction to the respondents to regularize the services of the petitioners on the post of Staff Nurses in terms of the policy/instructions dated 18.03.2011 (Annexure P-2).

2. Learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners, on instructions from the petitioners, submits that at this stage, he will be satisfied if a direction is given to respondent No.2 to decide the legal notice dated 22.09.2025 (Annexure P-9) served by the petitioners, in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion. CWP-37967-2025 32:

4. Mr. Amarpreet Singh Bains, AAG, Punjab, accepts notice on behalf of respondents-State and does not object to the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioners.

5. In view of the above and without commenting upon the merits of the case, this petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to consider and decide the legal notice dated 22.09.2025 (Annexure P-9), served by the petitioners within a period of 04 months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order in accordance with law.

6. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand(s) disposed of accordingly. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) JUDGE 19.12.2025 Ramandeep Singh
